en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Raib, from Ziyad Bin Sowqat, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘There is no problem if one of you were to pray Salāt in the one cloth and his loin cloth is loose. The Religion of Muhammadsaww is faultless’.
en.sarwar: 8. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from ibn Mahbub from ibn Ri’ab from Ziyad ibn Suqah who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

It is not an offense if one of you perform Salah (prayer) in one piece of cloth and his loincloth is not secured; religion of Muhammad, O Allah grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, is upright.’”
